title: Read a query value
summary: NestJS: Read a query value. Try /search with no query.
introduction: @Query reads the query string. Visit GET /search?q=cat. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Read a query value with NestJS

blocks.text: Create a practice project with npx @nestjs/cli new school. Replace src/main.ts with one complete example and run npm run start. Use http://127.0.0.1:3000. The original app files are unused by these small examples.

blocks.title: Read a query value

blocks.text: The Query decorator supplies q from the URL. Its value becomes the term field.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Validate query input before using it for important work.
